baselineReproduction: Four history-read regressions failed before correction: revocation during query, revocation during audit append, final role lookup outage and connection replacement during audit append all returned privileged success.
changes: Successful privileged reads recheck durable administrator authority and current connection ownership after both their data query and audit append, including a connection check after the final role lookup.
Late denial clears the entire privileged result while preserving request correlation and sanitized diagnostics. Status, online players, activity history and reports use the same completion boundary.

The authenticated completed query and its separate delivery denial are audited. Audit append failure uses the existing exact-event disk/RAM recovery path and never authorizes private data. No new store, financial operation, role policy or schema is introduced.

checks.newCoverage: Thirteen injected query/audit transition cases across all four privileged read kinds; actual disk journal reopen and exact denial replay, followed by a duplicate-free second drain. Existing read admission, privacy, reports, session audit and mutation regressions also pass.
checks.correctedCheckError: The first expanded test invocation did not compile because its audit comparison used Message instead of the existing Summary field. Corrected before the accepted run; no checks from the failed invocation count as passed.
checks.hygiene: gofmt and git diff --check passed. Isolated synthetic accounts and temporary journals only; no production account, wallet, service or database changes.

limits: Controlled in-process IO-boundary regressions, not a new two-account connected acceptance or a claim that a remote role lookup and network delivery are atomic. Existing retained administration acceptance remains separate.

The existing simultaneous Mongo/disk outage fallback is bounded RAM only. Readiness and clean shutdown fail closed until recovery, but forced process loss can discard RAM-only activity. No new crash durability is claimed.

Prepared source is not versioned, pushed or deployed as 1.74. Accepted live remains Alpha1.70.2 at526bc22953e79cbe4869580e8f628d55c39c1b1c. Ordered predecessor decisions and release gates, administration review and the full later roadmap remain open.
proposedPatchNote: Administration screens discard private results if your administrator access or connection changes while a read is in progress. Late denials retain correlated audit history through the existing storage-recovery path.
